meta.description: Build practical knowledge through training on carbon markets, CBAM, ETS, climate finance, Article 6, MRV, GHG accounting and climate policy.

hero.title: Training & Capacity Building
hero.lead: Green Gate Advisory supports training and capacity-building programmes tailored to the knowledge requirements of public institutions, businesses, exporters, project teams and other stakeholders. Training formats, scope and depth are discussed and confirmed based on institutional objectives.

intro.heading: Building Climate Knowledge & Practical Delivery Capacity
intro.p1: Climate regulation, international carbon mechanisms, and sustainable finance requirements demand specialized institutional competencies. Green Gate Advisory designs bespoke training and capacity-building programmes to bridge the gap between high-level climate ambition and day-to-day technical execution.
intro.p2: Our training programmes support public ministries, industrial compliance teams, project sponsors, and financial analysts—equipping teams with the technical tools, regulatory clarity, and methodological frameworks needed to deliver credible climate outcomes.

pillars.policy: National climate policy design, NDC alignment, and international negotiation mechanics
pillars.markets: Voluntary carbon market methodologies, baseline rules, and additionality testing
pillars.compliance: EU CBAM embedded emissions calculations and ETS allowance compliance obligations
pillars.finance: Climate finance proposal formulation for GCF, GEF, Adaptation Fund, and bilateral facilities
pillars.preparation: Project Design Document (PDD) preparation, feasibility studies, and digital MRV planning
pillars.reporting: GHG Protocol Scope 1, 2, and 3 accounting boundaries and primary supplier data workflows
pillars.governance: Environmental decision-making frameworks, safeguards, and Paris Agreement transparency

intro.notice: Scope discipline: Training scope, format, depth and duration are confirmed collaboratively with the client based on specific learning requirements and existing participant expertise. We do not publish pre-set course fees, rigid curricula or unverified certificates.

topics.heading: Eleven Potential Training Topics
topics.subtitle: Modular technical subjects tailored to your organisation's operational, compliance, or project development priorities.

fundamentals.title: Carbon Markets Fundamentals
fundamentals.desc: Foundational architecture of voluntary carbon markets, crediting standards, compliance systems, registries, and carbon credit life-cycles.
fundamentals.scope: Examines Verra, Gold Standard, baseline methodologies, additionality criteria, validation cycles, registries, and commercial credit trading dynamics.

vcmDevelopment.title: Voluntary Carbon Market Project Development
vcmDevelopment.desc: Comprehensive walkthrough of project design documents (PDDs), stakeholder consultations, digital MRV, and registration milestones.
vcmDevelopment.scope: Focus on opportunity screening, additionality demonstration, leakage risk management, independent validation preparation, and issuance procedures.

etsPricing.title: ETS & Carbon Pricing Mechanisms
etsPricing.desc: Structure and operation of compliance emissions trading schemes, allowance allocation formulas, auctions, and surrender protocols.
etsPricing.scope: Examines cap-and-trade systems, carbon taxes, internal carbon pricing, benchmark thresholds, and portfolio compliance management.

cbamEmissions.title: CBAM Requirements & Embedded Emissions Data
cbamEmissions.desc: Regulatory compliance under the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, calculation methodologies, and supplier data collection.
cbamEmissions.scope: Covers CN codes, direct and indirect emissions boundaries, precursor accounting, default vs. primary values, and quarterly reporting communication.

proposalWriting.title: Climate Finance Proposal Writing
proposalWriting.desc: Formulation of competitive concept notes and funding proposals aligned with international climate fund criteria.
proposalWriting.scope: Focus on climate rationale drafting, theory of change design, logframes, risk matrices, gender action plans, and budget justifications.

multilateralFunds.title: GCF, GEF & Adaptation Fund Programme Orientation
multilateralFunds.desc: Navigating access windows, accreditation types, country ownership, and strategic priorities of major multilateral funds.
multilateralFunds.scope: Detailed review of investment criteria, simplified approval processes, direct access entities, ESS standards, and co-financing rules.

lossAndDamage.title: Climate Finance Programming Related to Loss and Damage
lossAndDamage.desc: Emerging funding mechanisms, vulnerability diagnostics, and financial instruments addressing slow-onset events and climate extremes.
lossAndDamage.scope: Review of UNFCCC Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage frameworks, parametric risk transfer, non-economic loss methodologies, and community resilience.

article6.title: Article 6 & Cooperative Approaches
article6.desc: Operationalisation of Paris Agreement Article 6.2 bilateral agreements, Article 6.4 crediting mechanisms, and ITMO governance.
article6.scope: Corresponding adjustments, authorization processes, national registries, transfer agreements, and double-counting prevention mechanisms.

natureBased.title: Nature-Based Solutions, Blue Carbon & Land Restoration
natureBased.desc: Designing high-integrity terrestrial and coastal ecosystem interventions that integrate carbon, biodiversity, and community benefits.
natureBased.scope: Mangrove restoration, peatland rewetting, agroforestry carbon estimation, Free Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC), and permanence buffers.

mrvAccounting.title: MRV, Transparency & Greenhouse Gas Accounting
mrvAccounting.desc: Rigorous emissions accounting frameworks under GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, ISO 14064, and Paris Agreement ETF.
mrvAccounting.scope: Scope 1, 2, and 3 accounting boundaries, activity data collection, emission factor selection, and independent verification readiness.

policyNegotiations.title: Climate Policy & Climate Negotiation Support
policyNegotiations.desc: Institutional capacity building for climate delegations, NDC updating processes, and domestic policy alignment.
policyNegotiations.scope: UNFCCC negotiation tracks, global stocktake implications, Long-Term Low Emission Development Strategies (LT-LEDS), and stakeholder consultations.
